title: CSIR IMTECH Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Project Associate I Posts
description: CSIR-Institute of Microbial Technology (CSIR IMTECH) has released the official notification for the recruitment of various Project Associate I positions. Those candidates who have completed their M.V.Sc., M.Pharm, or M.Sc. can grab this chance and apply for the CSIR IMTECH Notification 2026 . Here we provide more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
